description: Fix 15 dashboard UX issues: collision fixes (layout zones, chapter nav, controls), explanation fixes (labels, legends, text), chapter redesigns (predictor, strategy, compare), and mobile layout overhaul.

userStories.title: Move chapter nav dots to bottom rail with hover labels
userStories.description: As a user, I want chapter navigation that doesn't overlap charts so I can use the dashboard without UI collisions.
acceptanceCriteria: ChapterDots component moved from absolute right-side position to a fixed bottom nav rail (above scrubber, below main content)
Each dot shows chapter name label on hover/focus using title attribute or CSS tooltip
Nav rail has z-index above content, pointer-events contained to rail only
No dot overlaps any chart or content area on desktop or mobile
On mobile (< 640px), chapter nav renders as a horizontal segmented control at top of viewport with short chapter labels visible
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix top-left controls — driver chip above gauge + severity legend
userStories.description: As a user, I want the driver/year chip and severity legend positioned so they don't overlap the speedometer.
acceptanceCriteria: Driver/year chip (e.g. NOR · 2025) moved above or beside the speedometer gauge, not overlapping it
A severity probability legend added near the gauge: four labeled swatches — Severity 0 (Healthy), 1 (Mild), 2 (Moderate), 3 (Critical) — using the existing color scale
Legend is compact (row of small color chips with text labels), placed below driver chip or beside gauge
Controls zone is protected: nothing else overlays the top-left quadrant
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix confidence bar — labeled mini legend, hide labels below 12%
userStories.description: As a user, I want the confidence/probability bar to show all four severity classes with human-readable labels.
acceptanceCriteria: Confidence bar shows all four probability segments: Healthy, Mild, Moderate, Critical (currently missing one class)
Each segment has a text label showing the class name and percent, e.g. 'Healthy 54%'
Labels with value < 12% are hidden visually but still accessible via tooltip or aria-label on the segment
A mini legend title reads 'Severity probability' above or beside the bar
Bar total always sums to 100% (verify data normalization)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix corner heatmap — title, legend, dedicated lower panel
userStories.description: As a user, I want the corner heatmap in a fixed dedicated zone with clear legend so I understand what red intensity means.
acceptanceCriteria: CornerHeatmap component renders in a dedicated lower panel with fixed height (e.g. 120px) above the lap scrubber, not randomly positioned
Panel has a title: 'Corner Stress by Lap'
A legend row below the heatmap shows: a gradient bar from dark (low) to red (high) with labels 'Low stress' and 'High stress' and note 'Darker red = higher corner stress proxy'
Corner labels (Copse, MB, Stowe, Club) are legible — minimum font size 10px
Panel does not overlap scrubber or any other content
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix race arc — rename modeled laps, add severity scale legend
userStories.description: As a user, I want the race arc text and legend to be clear so I understand what '29 laps' means.
acceptanceCriteria: Change '29 Predicted Laps (of 52)' to '29 modeled laps from telemetry · 52 race laps total'
Add a severity scale legend to the race arc view: small colored row showing which color = which severity (Healthy/Mild/Moderate/Critical)
Remove any visible scrollbar from the race arc area (overflow hidden or auto where appropriate)
Legend is placed within the race arc chapter zone, not floating outside
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Rename SIM button to Strategy Simulator, move to strategy section
userStories.description: As a user, I want the simulator button clearly labeled and located near the strategy content so it feels related.
acceptanceCriteria: SIM button text changed to 'Strategy Simulator' (or 'Open Simulator' if space-constrained)
Button moved to within or directly adjacent to the strategy chapter section, not floating near timeline/bars
Button position does not overlap any chart or timeline element
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Expand SIM drawer labels — full compound names, descriptions, 0.0s message
userStories.description: As a user, I want the simulator drawer to use plain language so I understand all options and results without jargon.
acceptanceCriteria: Compound abbreviations expanded: S → Soft, M → Medium, H → Hard, INT → Intermediate, W → Wet
'Finish Sev' label changed to 'Projected finish severity'
'Multiplier' label changed to 'Compound degradation multiplier'
When delta time is 0.0s, display 'No meaningful gain/loss' instead of 'LOST 0.0s' or similar zero-value text
Drawer layout is readable with no truncated or overflowing text
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix technical toggle — two-layer plain explanation + expandable technical details
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a plain-language explanation always visible, with optional technical details expandable below.
acceptanceCriteria: Every instance of the technical toggle renders a plain-language explanation visible by default (not behind toggle)
Technical details are in an expandable section below, triggered by a 'Technical details ▸' button/disclosure
Technical details render as formatted bullet points, not raw inline strings
Consistent pattern applied across all chapters that have a technical toggle
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Predictor chapter — two-column panel, corner rings as background-only
userStories.description: As a user, I want the predictor chapter to show SHAP bars clearly without the circuit ring overlapping them.
acceptanceCriteria: Predictor chapter renders in a two-column layout: left column = 'Why this lap?' label + SHAP bars; right column = corner stress heatmap or secondary info
Corner ring visuals (MB ring, Copse ring) moved behind content with reduced opacity (≤ 0.15) as decorative background, not competing with bar chart
'Top predictors' heading positioned above SHAP bars, not overlapping circuit imagery
SHAP bars are fully readable with no content crossing over them
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Strategy chapter — three-zone dashboard layout + result sentence
userStories.description: As a user, I want the strategy chapter to look like a decision dashboard with clear recommendation and pit-window chart.
acceptanceCriteria: Strategy chapter uses a three-zone layout: left = recommendation summary (UNDERCUT OPPORTUNITY text, large and readable), center = pit-window bars with labeled Y-axis and X-axis (lap numbers), right = outcome explanation panel
Pit-window bars have axis labels and gridlines so severity scale is clear
A one-sentence result summary shown: e.g. 'Best window: L18–L26 — projected finish severity stays lowest.' using actual computed values from data
Strategy content does not compete with or overlap the speedometer
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Season compare chapter — chart-focused layout, remove center tire, add legend/axes
userStories.description: As a user, I want the season comparison to be a proper chart view without the unrelated center tire visual.
acceptanceCriteria: Center tire animation/visual removed from season compare chapter (unrelated to cross-season data)
CrossSeasonChart is the primary and dominant visual, taking 60%+ of the available content area
Chart has labeled X-axis (Race progress %) and Y-axis (Degradation severity), with gridlines
Chart legend shows each year as a colored line with year label (e.g. 2021, 2024) — labels not compressed
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Mobile predictor — stacked layout, hide circuit overlays
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the predictor chapter content stacked vertically so SHAP bars and heatmap don't collide with circuit visuals.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (< 640px), predictor chapter stacks vertically: explanation text → SHAP bars → corner heatmap
Circuit ring overlays (Copse, MB) hidden on mobile (display:none or opacity:0) — decorative background on desktop only
SHAP bars do not overflow or overlap chapter dot nav on mobile
Corner heatmap on mobile has safe bottom padding to not collide with scrubber
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Mobile overall — stacked narrative cards, circuit as faint background
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want all dashboard chapters to render as stacked readable sections with no absolute-positioned overlays covering content.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (< 640px), all chapters render as vertically stacked content sections — no absolute-positioned overlays on top of readable content
Circuit/track image used as a faint CSS background (opacity ≤ 0.08) on mobile — no large circuit SVG/PNG overlaid on content
Each section has min 16px horizontal padding so content does not touch screen edges
Lap scrubber stays fixed at bottom with safe-area-inset-bottom padding
All charts and text readable without horizontal scroll
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
